We’re hiring mail sorters for PostNL in Nieuwegein (Grote Wade 80, 3439 NT). With no fixed hours but shifts lasting 3 to 5 hours, you'll need to be flexible and ready to work at least 15 hours weekly. Bring your own ride, and let’s sort through some mail and make the night count! Manpower employment agency is looking for mail sorters for night shifts at PostNL in Nieuwegein.  In the role of a mail sorter, you’ll handle the machine sorting of national mail. The job requires physical effort—you’ll stand for long periods and regularly lift heavy mail trays. Precision is crucial because every piece of mail needs to arrive at the right destination. What's in it for you     - From the age of 18 a gross salary of €14.99 (excluding bonuses)    - Reimbursement of travel costs     - Temporary employment contract      - Pension accrual via Manpower     - Free access to E-learning platform Manpower Academy     - Irregularity allowance of 20% for working between 8:00 PM and 10:00 PM, and 40% for working between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM    - Strong command of Dutch and/or English to ensure clear communication and adherence to safety guidelines    - Own transportation to accommodate working early mornings, evenings, and night shifts    - Capability to submit a valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)Excited to start your journey at PostNL? Submit your application now, and Manpower will reach out within two business days!
